title: Chocolate Caramel Crispy
hookLine: British-inspired chocolate caramel crispy with 4 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Grease and line a 20 x 20cm/8" x 8" baking tin with parchment paper. Keep {m52966_1}, {m52966_2}, {m52966_3}, and {m52966_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure mars bar first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Put the mars bars and butter in a heat proof bowl and place over a pan of barely simmering water. Mixing with a whisk, melt until the mixture is smooth.

steps.title: Portion, Shape & Layer Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour over the rice krispies in a mixing bowl and mix until all the ingredients are evenly combined. Press evenly into the prepare baking tin and set aside.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt the milk chocolate in the microwave or over a pan of barely simmering water. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread the melted chocolate over the rice krispie mixture and leave to set in a cool place. Once set slice into squares and serve!
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
